messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Shopping and Retail" as it appears in the following examples.
['eBay member Rapid has left you a message regarding item #270577199428', 'Your order has been successfully canceled.', "Your Apple ID was just used for the acquisition of quot;CTW Lite" from the iTunes Store on a PC or another device that hadn't earlier been associated with that Apple ID.", 'Buy quality replicas at reasonable prices.', 'After this period, the required amount will be debited from your payment account and the signup will be activated.', 'Your Order with Amazon.com Thanks for your order, joker@highwayman.com', 'This is an email confirmation for your order of 1 online shipping label(s) with postage.', 'Your order ID:778-1442536 accepted.', 'eBay member Giovanna has left you a message regarding item #2801119587** on Monday, 25 May, 2009.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
